violations_summary: Manufacturer Name: No manufacturer or corporate identity detected on packaging, invoking strict penal liability under Section 36(1) of the Act.; Manufacturer Name: Mandatory declaration 'Manufacturer / Packer / Importer Name' is missing from the package label.; Manufacturer Address: Complete postal address of the manufacturer or packer is missing from the packaging.; Mrp: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) declaration is completely missing from the package in violation of Rule 6(1)(e) and Section 18 of the Act.; Country Of Origin: Country of Origin declaration ('Made in India' / 'Country of Origin') was not detected on the package.; Declaration Placement: Rule 8 placement violation detected: Printed information encroaches into the statutory clear space surrounding the net quantity numeral in violation of Rule 8(1) Proviso. Detected 3 encroaching text element(s) (e.g. 'Batch No. :See CapBodom').
